issues.description: The template repository provides a class named Order (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Order.java) while the problem statement and the solution use a class named Meal. The problem statement explicitly states that Meal is provided/used. The template's Meal.java is empty. This identifier mismatch (Order vs Meal / missing Meal implementation in template) will confuse students because they will expect a ready-to-use Meal class and matching file, and the starter code instead contains an Order class with the same structure.
issues.suggestedFix: Provide a Meal class in the template matching the problem statement (e.g., copy/rename the Order class to Meal and place it in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Meal.java), and ensure Meal.java is non-empty with getName() and getIngredients() methods. Update any references in Main or other template files to use Meal rather than Order so names align with the problem description and solution.
